description: `_project/analysis/snowflake-trial-exit/snowflake_campaign.py statement-history` calls `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY(END_TIME_RANGE_START => '<since>'::TIMESTAMP_TZ, ...)`.
